'''April 2001 Pleasanton tournament (7 April)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Warmasters, Pleasanton, California on 7 April 2001. [[Michael Mendoza]] won it. It is known from Michael Mendoza's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2034">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-pleasanton-ca-4-7-01d2034/ pleasanton-ca-4-7-01], DeckTech (Michael "Longshot" Mendoza, 8 April 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-04-08-pleasanton-ca-4-7-01d2034/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 7 April 2001
* '''Site:''' Warmasters, Pleasanton, California
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 20
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Mendoza]]
